source_title: The Divine Madness of Philip K. Dick: A Psychiatric and Philosophical Perspective
access_notes: Scholarly analysis of 2-3-74 experiences and PKD's psychiatric/theological frameworks. Proposes clinical interpretations alongside PKD's own accounts.
notes: Lane C scholarship: Kyle Arnold's clinical analysis of the 2-3-74 experiences, examining diagnostic possibilities (bipolar, TLE, etc.) while respecting PKD's own interpretation. Essential for grounding visionary experiences in biographical/medical context.
